requirements.text: An element in a graph along its location within that graph.
A basic element with a name.
A Graph object has a type and a dimension.
A GraphElement has a label and a z index.
A Node element has a shape.
A DirectedArc links a source node and a target node and has a shape.
A Graph object is composed of any number (or none) of GraphElements.
A GraphElement contains a reference to its parent Graph.
